title: Steamed Caramel Pudding
description: A creamy, smooth caramel pudding made with cream cheese, evaporated milk and bread, steamed until set and best served cold straight from the fridge.
description_ms: Puding karamel berkrim yang diperbuat daripada campuran roti, krim cheese dan krimer sejat, dikukus sehingga lembut dan paling sedap dimakan sejuk dari peti ais.
steps: Place 0.5 cup sugar in a dry pan and swirl over medium heat — do not stir with a spoon — until fully melted into golden caramel.
Immediately pour the hot caramel into a baking tin; it is extremely hot so handle with care.
Remove and discard the hard crusts from 2 slices of white bread.
Blend 2 cup evaporated milk, the trimmed bread, 4 eggs, 0.5 cup sweetened condensed milk, 0.5 cup cream cheese, 1 tsp vanilla essence, and a pinch of salt until completely smooth.
Strain the blended mixture through a sieve.
Rest a ladle underneath the stream and slowly pour the strained mixture into the caramel-lined tin to avoid splashing.
Wrap the tin tightly with aluminium foil.
Steam over medium-low heat for 45 minutes.
Allow to cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 2–3 hours before serving.
steps_ms: Masukkan setengah cawan gula ke dalam kuali kering, gerak-gerakkan atas api sederhana — jangan kacau dengan sudu — sehingga gula cair dan jadi caramel keemasan.
Tuangkan caramel ke dalam loyang dengan segera; sangat panas jadi berhati-hati.
Potong dan buang bahagian keras tepi 2 keping roti putih.
Blend 2 cawan krimer sejat, roti yang dipotong, 4 biji telur, setengah cawan krimer manis, setengah cawan krim cheese, 1 sudu kecil esen vanila, dan garam sikit sehingga sebati.
Letakkan senduk di bawah aliran dan tuang adunan yang ditapis ke dalam loyang beralas caramel secara perlahan.
Balut loyang dengan aluminium foil rapat-rapat.
Kukus atas api sederhana-kecil selama 45 minit.
Biarkan cool down sepenuhnya, kemudian simpan dalam peti sejuk sekurang-kurangnya 2–3 jam sebelum dihidang.
